payload.rewritten_goal:
You are coordinating a team of ecommerce specialists for customer Diego Valera regarding delivered order # and dispute case The payments team provided a payment gateway screenshot and a card-network response document after Diego claimed a duplicate capture occurred during checkout, and support must determine whether to issue a refund or route the matter for formal chargeback handling. Reference entity IDs: customer id, request id. MANDATORY steps: 1. authenticate Diego Valera and confirm the active customer profile, 2. inspect the dispute case history and authoritative order payment record to determine whether the duplicate-charge claim is supported, 3. consult the exact chargeback and duplicate-capture handling article, 4. if the evidence supports an internal correction, issue the appropriate refund or store credit; otherwise route the case to the chargeback operations queue, 5. provide a concise final summary of the decision and action taken.

Relevant document evidence summaries are inlined below:
- card network response CASE CB 60488: Card-network response document summarizing issuer/network disposition for the alleged duplicate charge tied to case CASE-CB-60488. Extracted content: Card Network Response Case-Cb-60488 Card-network response document summarizing issuer/network disposition for the alleged duplicate charge tied to case CASE-CB-60488. Details Document title references dispute case CASE-CB-60488 and order EC-60488. Customer name Diego Valera and customer ID CUS-6048 are listed in the case summary. Network/issuer response identifies the customer-reported second debit as a pending or reversed authorization hold rather than a second clearing/capture. The document states that only one clearing record/financial presentment was received for order EC-60488. The network response recommends merchant-side duplicate-capture correction only when multiple settled presentments exist; otherwise standard dispute/chargeback handling applies if the cardholder proceeds. The document includes the relevant card reference IDs matching the gateway screenshot events. The response shows no evidence of duplicate settled capture for the same order amount. Additional Information a summary table with merchant reference, card reference IDs, amount '$184 In the findings section, explicitly state that one financial presentment/clearing record was received and that the additional same-amount event corresponds to a temporary authorization hold that was reversed or expired before clearing Page 2 include a concise operational note indicating that duplicate-capture remediation applies only when more than one settled capture/presentment exists; absent duplicate clearing, the merchant not issue an internal duplicate-capture refund solely on the basis of a pending authorization claim, and if the cardholder persists the matter proceed through formal chargeback/dispute handling Use formal business language and a realistic document layout with footer page numbers This memo is con
- knowledge article chargeback vs duplicate capture policy: Internal policy article defining how to distinguish duplicate capture from authorization holds and when to refund versus route to chargeback operations. Extracted content: Knowledge Article Chargeback VS Duplicate Capture Policy Internal policy article defining how to distinguish duplicate capture from authorization holds and when to refund versus route to chargeback operations. Details The article contains the exact handling guidance for duplicate-capture claims versus pending authorization disputes. It states that refunds or store credit may be issued internally only when the authoritative payment record shows more than one settled capture/clearing for the same order. It states that duplicate authorization holds, pending authorizations, or reversed holds do not qualify for duplicate-capture refunds. It instructs staff to rely on the order payment record plus gateway/network evidence before issuing any correction. It states that when no duplicate settled capture exists and a cardholder continues disputing, the case must be routed to the chargeback operations queue. It includes a note to document the final action under request ID CASE-CB-60488 or equivalent case record. Additional Information precise policy text: (1) authenticate customer and confirm active profile; (2) verify authoritative order payment record and compare with gateway/network evidence; (3) issue refund/store credit only if multiple settled captures/clearings exist for the same order and amount; (4) do not refund for pending authorizations, duplicate auth holds, reversals, or issuer-side display artifacts; (5) if customer still contests and no duplicate settled capture exists, route to 'Chargeback Operations' queue; (6) record the action in the case file This policy is confidential and intended for authorized recipients only.
